The petitioner has filed this petition under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for enlarging him on bail in Crime No.32/2024 of Shikaripura Town Police Station, Shivamogga District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(b), 323, 504, 506 of IPC and Section 67(B) of Information Technology Act 2000, pending on the file of the Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Shikaripura.

sentences.text: 2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned HCGP for the Respondent-State.
Perused the records.
3. The allegations of the prosecution discloses that, the victim is working in a Government School at Shikaripura as a guest teacher, wherein the petitioner is also is working as Assistant Teacher.

It is alleged that when the victim used to give training to the students to play volley ball, the petitioner made all the efforts to come closer to the victim and then gained her confidence NC:
2024:KHC:15142 asserting that he is very influential person and he would get a Government Job to her by using his influence.

Later on, the petitioner is alleged to have started misbehaving with the victim by blinking his eyes towards the her and touch her inappropriately and on questioning his act, he asserted that he liked her and he always like to see her.
It is alleged that since the complainant/victim was a part time employee, she was not raising any voice due to fear of losing her job.
It is alleged that, on 16.09.2023 at 9.30 a.m., the petitioner asked the victim girl to come to office room and when she went there, he forcibly hugged her and raped her, despite her resistance.

According to the prosecution, subsequently he started to demand her to send her obscene photos and under fear, she used to send her obscene photos to him through whatsapp and then by using them, he started expecting sexual favour from her and used to blackmail her.
It is alleged that, on 09.10.2023, 15.11.2023 and 16.11.2023 the petitioner took her to different places and committed penetrative sexual assault on her.

On 16.01.2023 at about 12.00 NC: 2024:KHC:15142 noon, he after signing attendance register visited her house and disrobed himself and at that time, she secured her husband and then he has given an unconditional apology letter to her husband and

even after that,
again he continued his attitude and hence, complaint was lodged.
On the basis of the complaint, FIR came to be registered and the petitioner was arrested and was remanded to judicial custody.

4. The main contention of the learned counsel for the petitioner is that, even if the allegations made in the case of prosecution accepted, it is to be treated as a consensual sex, as both the parties are teachers by profession and both are married persons.

He would contend that the allegations of sexual assault on 16.09.2023 at 11.30 a.m., in the office room of the school, wherein both of them are working, cannot be accepted as it was the school working hours.
He would further contend that the victim with an intention to blackmail the petitioner has filed a false case against him.

The learned counsel NC: 2024:KHC:15142 has also contended that the petitioner also undertakes to Lingraj Naika H vs The State Of Karnataka on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76687612/
2 abide by all the terms and conditions to be imposed by this Court and sought for admitting him on bail.

sentences.text: 5. Per contra, the learned HCGP would seriously oppose the bail petition contending that there is material evidence as against the petitioner and sought for dismissal of the petition.
6. The allegations of the prosecution discloses that the victim/complainant is aged about 31 years and she is a married woman.

Both the parties are working as teachers in a Government School at Shikaripura and it is alleged that the petitioner developed intimacy with her and later started to expect sexual favour from her and on 16.09.2023 at 11.30 a.m., in the office room of their school, he committed rape on her.
It is interesting to note here that there is allegation of rape in the school office room during working hours.
This appears to be unnatural, as she has not raised any hue and cry for help and further, she never reported the matter to the Head NC: 2024:KHC:15142 Master of the school.
Admittedly, the petitioner is not her immediate superior and he is not the controlling authority of the school.
The other allegations are that, he asked her to send obscene photos and then she used to send her obscene photos to him through whatsapp.
If there is no intimacy between them, question of the victim sending her obscene photos to the petitioner does not arise at all.

When she had voluntarily sent her obscene photos, it is evident that it was a consensual sexual relationship and only when they were caught red-handed on 16.01.2024, it is alleged that then the complaint was lodged.
But, however the complaint was lodged on 13.02.2024 i.e., almost one month later.
It is hard to accept that the victim was able to sustain this sexual assault continuously without informing anybody in this regard.

Hence, the conduct of the victim considering her age and her marital status,
it is evident that it appears to be a consensual sexual relationship.

However, the petitioner is already in judicial custody and major portion of the investigation appears to have been concluded and hence, NC: 2024:KHC:15142 his custodial presence is no more required by the Investigating Agency.
The other apprehensions raised by the learned HCGP can be meted-out by imposing certain conditions.
Hence, considering the conduct of the victim, I do not find any impediment for admitting the petitioner on bail.

Hence, the petition needs to be allowed and accordingly, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER I.
The petition is allowed.

II. The petitioner/Accused is directed to be enlarged on bail in Crime No.32/2024 of Shikaripura Town Police Station, Shivamogga District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(b), 323, 504, 506 of IPC and Section 67(B) of Information Technology Act 2000, pending on the file of the Senior Civil Judge and JMFC, Shikaripura., on his executing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
(Rupees One Lakh only) with one surety for the like-sum to the satisfaction of the trial Court, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) He shall not indulge in any of the criminal activities.
